source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting results that contradict the hypothesis in a psychology research report

1. Start with the research records.
2.
completion:
Develop an explanation for the discrepancy.
3. Draft the results section, focusing on what you have documented.
4. Draft a well-thought-out but error-free conclusion.
5. Review the literature to see if there is an alternative explanation for the results.
6. Document the revised literature for the final draft.

The following video describes the steps for appropriately documenting inaccurate results that do not support the hypothesis:

https://youtu.be/V-g197N2p6g

For additional information about writing a Psychology Research Report, please visit the APA Style Blog here: https://apastyle.apa.org/style-grammar-guidelines/paper-format/sample-papers<eos>
